analytical_narrative.text: The product separates volume, FARO quality, commercial matched cost-quality, concentration, temporality and material limits.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: The product has sufficient FARO coverage to describe lead quality: 1632 leads, 504 A/B leads and 76 Tier A leads.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: This is FARO quality, not revenue or CRM outcome.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: Cost-quality must be read in the commercial matched universe: 12 matched ads, 1458 leads and 1069.05001 matched commercial spend, with lead_only and spend_only preserved.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: lead_only is not zero cost and spend_only is not proof of no leads.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: Observed quality is explained by combinations of FARO tier, ticket_status, form/campaign concentration and ad-level coverage.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: The evidence supports association, not creative causality.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: Monthly evolution is usable and June is the largest observed month; weekly comparability is partial because provider periods are incomplete at the edges.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: Spend ends on 2026-07-17 while leads extend to 2026-07-22.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: The main ABO campaign concentrates most leads; ticket_status has strong descriptive separation between solo_mirando, en_proceso and tiene_billetes.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: Campaign/adset economics remain partial because spend reconciliation is robust at ad_id level.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: Material limits must stay visible in both projections: revenue/CRM not_available, creative causality UNKNOWN, metadata not_available and temporal coverage partial.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: Presentation cannot turn these limits into a positive or negative finding.

priorities.basis: Prioritize controlled commercial matched tests before broad budget changes.
Review coverage states before interpreting economic gaps.
Keep future-evidence gaps declared until new authorized evidence exists.

risks: treating partial weekly data as complete
unknowns: UNKNOWN: causal effect of creative/ad_name on lead quality.
UNKNOWN: commercial revenue or CRM outcome of FARO tiers.
UNKNOWN: complete current-week cost-quality pattern after provider spend cutoff.
